# About 

I'm currently a lecturer in bioinformatics at the University of Hong Kong. I teach fundamental biostatistics, bioinformatics, and machine learning courses. Prior to my current position, I worked at the HKJC Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention at the University of Hong Kong. By training, I am a data scientist and industrial engineer. I specialize in analyzing and leveraging data and technology to promote mental health at both individual and population levels. 

## Contact

For inquiries or to contribute materials, please contact us at [ychsu@hku.hk](mailto:ychsu@hku.hk).
